children: AllianceBernstein reported preliminary assets under management of $919 billion as of August 31, 2026, up from $908 billion at July-end.
Preliminary AUM increased 1.2% to $919B as of Aug 31, 2026, from $908B on Jul 31, 2026.
Increase driven by market appreciation, partially offset by net outflows.
Institutional and Private Wealth saw net inflows while Retail experienced net outflows.
AUM by capability: Equity $364B, Fixed Income $323B, Alternatives/Multi-Asset $232B.
